about: Forever notes (task 011): the crippled cases only, an addon that has a Forever build but half works under Forever's combat restrictions. `kinds` are the restrictions, `addons` the notes, one per addon keyed by its source spec (github:<owner>/<repo>), each naming its kind, a one-line reason, the date it was verified against the source, and the source. A note older than 90 days is shown as stale. How to add one: docs/development.md, Forever notes.

secret-combat-values.reason: the addon restrictions of Midnight, secret values included, are active in Forever: an addon may show a hidden combat value but not compute with it

combat-log-events.reason: an addon that decides from combat log events or another player's combat state hits the combat restrictions; display-only use works

github:ascott18/TellMeWhen.reason: cooldowns are secret in combat: icons cannot sort, anchor or decide on a cooldown's state there

github:dldvlpr-addons-wow/Musca-Auras.reason: combat log triggers never fire and conditions on hidden combat data wait until combat ends: imported auras need adapting

github:michaelnpsp/Grid2.reason: auras are hidden from addons in combat: aura timers and remaining-time bars work only through the bar(auras) and text(auras) indicators

github:neroxrw/foreverauras.reason: the legacy aura trigger rarely works in combat: in-combat auras need the modern aura trigger
